title: Kehai marketing pipeline settings
description: tools/marketing/pipeline.json: when the pipeline produces and posts, where, what it keeps and for how long. No secrets (those are in .env). The schedules themselves are the n8n workflows' (tools/marketing/n8n).

timezone.description: IANA zone the days and times are in (the owner's), e.g. America/New_York.

pick_day.description: The day (its 1 a.m. run, or the first run after it that week if the Mac slept through it) the shorts are picked from the last 7 days' shifts, to be approved over the weekend and posted on the next posting days.

min_moments.description: Fewer moments than this in the week: no picks, and the owner is told.

retries.description: Times a failed step is tried again (on later runs) before it waits for the owner.

days.description: Days an approved short goes to Buffer's queue (Buffer's own schedule picks the time: Q14).

buffer.description: Buffer channels by service (the free plan allows 3: Q9).

languages.description: Which language's video goes to Buffer (Q16).

tiktok.description: manual: the file and caption come to Telegram on posting days, posted by hand.

max_upload_mb.description: Bots can send files up to 50 MB; bigger ones go as a smaller preview plus a Drive link.

retention.description: Q12. With apply false, housekeeping only reports what it would delete.

posted_days.description: Days after posting (and archiving) that a short's local files go.

shots_days.description: Days after its video is approved or rejected that a shot goes.

krec_days.description: Days after archiving that a .krec goes.

references_days.description: Days after a reference video arrived that it, its frames and its audio go (its study and its pattern stay). Default 30.

references.description: Videos the owner sends in Telegram to learn from (km/references.py).

per_week.description: How many of the week's shorts follow a reference the owner sent (the oldest first). 0 keeps them as library patterns only. Default 1.

day.description: Day of the month the long video for the month before starts.
